title: Visiting Newquay? Train with us.
seo_title: Gym in Newquay for visitors and drop-ins
seo_description: On holiday in Newquay? Hybrid Hub at Prow Park is open 24 hours, with coached classes and Hyperice recovery. Book a drop-in session.
intro: On holiday, surfing Fistral or here for work? Keep your training going at Hybrid Hub, a premium gym at Prow Park.
image_alt: The open gym at Hybrid Hub

blocks.title: Open gym
blocks.text: Premium equipment in a gym that's open 24 hours, so you can train around your plans.

blocks.title: Coached classes
blocks.text: HYROX, ATHX and hybrid strength and conditioning classes, from morning to evening.

blocks.title: Recovery
blocks.text: Hyperice Normatec compression, contrast therapy and the Vyper roller. Pay for a slot via the WodBoard shop.

faqs.question: Do I need to be a member to train?
faqs.answer: No. Book a drop-in session, leave your details and we'll call you to book you in.

faqs.question: When is the gym open?
faqs.answer: The gym is open 24 hours. Classes run from morning to evening; see the timetable on the Train page.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Your training kit, trainers and a water bottle.

faqs.question: Where are you?
faqs.answer: Prow Park, Newquay, Cornwall, TR7 2SX. Search for Hybrid Hub NQY in Google Maps, or use what3words ///curl.headset.grief.
